reviews.comment: Pretty unclear in lecture, learned most of class through reading textbook independently. Exams often included nonsensical questions. Allowed cheat sheet for each exam and allowed third exam to be retaken at home because was nonsensical, no final. Has a great fundamental understanding of thermo, can answer your conceptual questions very well.

Okay personally think his lectures are not amazing, sometimes puts me to sleep bc he talks a bit slow, but gives you the information to do well on the exams, which are relatively easy compared to other profs. His hand writting def stinks when he does write. He came in clutch on the final exam, letting us retake it at home due to a mistake.

Good prof that really tries to hone in major points. Exams are fairly simple and predictable if you go to lecture. Exams were 90% of our grade so studying for those by reviewing in class materials is essential.

We had a relatively small class size compared to the other sections. Would definitely recommend.

Had him for Heat and Bioprocess. Both times I had A's throughout the entire semester and then he gave a 35-40% final at the end. Both times I have gone from an A to ending with a B. All the other assignments are worthless. Lectures are useless. His exams are just homework questions or some questions he does in class but with different numbers.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were very easy to understand, while not recorded. This meant you really had to pay attention, ask questions, and note what you might have missed. This was very helpful to me personally, and I think I had the easiest time in this class than any other this semester. Dr. Lele is a great prof, very accessible via email/zoom. Would take again!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I enjoyed taking CHEN 323 with Dr. Lele. He switched to video proctoring instead of Honor Lock, which I hear is a pain to use. His lectures are concise and interactive, and he holds office hours immediately after for anyone with longer questions. Homework every 2 weeks. Exams are 85% of your grade. The overall curve is based on class participation.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: CHEN482 is not a conceptually difficult course, but taking it with Dr. Lele was a distinctively negative experience. Classes were extremely disorganized and lectures were generally ineffective. He adapted poorly to online learning- exams were horrendous due to the proctoring systems he chose. Not a great prof.

Taking a class with Professor Lele was the worst experience. He was unreasonable and extremely unorganized. Refused to record any of his lectures and when asked if he could post his notes, he refused and told us to get them from classmates. Exams/ quizzes were a nightmare because of proctoring systems he chose. Only learned by reading the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes
